pocket.name: A conserved conformational face that joins the exposed aromatic...
pocket.why_this_rank: C2 has the closest other-antibody topological precedent, but it is the widest footprint, slightly exceeds the stated radius when exposed side chains define the edge, and depends most strongly on transferring a conformation-sensitive 3G12 mode to a sequence-distinct Fab.
pocket.rests_on: The supplied Fab can realize the flexible-flank, heavy-biased broad mode despite using essentially the full paratope reach.
pocket.what_it_is: A conserved conformational face that joins the exposed aromatic N-terminal flank of a small viral attachment domain to the near shoulder of its disulfide-pinned loop; folding makes the HFEVF-rich strand and the serine/asparagine noose shoulder one continuous antibody-facing surface.
pocket.why_one_candidate: not pooled with anything: no other patch is both within 12 A (half centroid distance, half contact-graph hops) and coverable by one paratope of this antibody's reach, 17.0 A

note: `confidence` on the pocket is over pockets and sums to about 1 across them. Inside an interface it is per residue in [0, 1] and sums to nothing. No residue is cut at a threshold: the whole vector is the answer.

paratope.heavy_light_split: Strongly heavy-biased, about 70:30. H2/H3 and H1 cover A:7-A:19, with both chains meeting at A:15-A:20; L1/L3 close over the A:21-A:23/A:26/A:33 polar and folded-back rim.

pooling_provenance.note: counts only, describing how the organizer grouped the phase-1 patches. The organizer's own candidate residue list is deliberately absent: the answer is the advocate's footprint, in `residues` and in `antibodies[].interfaces[]`.

advocate.weakest_point: The strongest support is a sequence-distinct 3G12 analogue whose binding requires a particular flexible-flank conformation. This Fab has different CDRs and a 14-residue, only partly exposed H3; the 28.05-A footprint uses much of its reach. The isolated antigen prediction may therefore display a flank/shoulder conformation that the biological ensemble does not populate for this antibody, and no target-specific experiment distinguishes this broad face from the adjacent noose crest.
advocate.note: the advocate reports claim/source/date/bearing and is not asked whether a source is about this binder

judge.note: Tier A -- a source about this binder itself -- is the judge's adjudication, in assessment[].support[]. It exists nowhere in the advocate's own answer.
